description: This file contains CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) functions for managing users and games in a tic-tac-toe platform, interacting with the database via SQLAlchemy ORM models.

methods.name: Optional[models.User] create_user(db: Session, username: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user with the given username, returns the user if successful, or None if the username already exists.

methods.name: Optional[models.User] get_user(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their ID.

methods.name: Optional[models.User] get_user_by_username(db: Session, username: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their username.

methods.name: List[models.User] list_users(db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Lists users with optional pagination parameters.

methods.name: models.Game create_game(db: Session, player_x_id: Optional[int], player_o_id: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new game instance, optionally specifying players X and O, and initializes its game state.

methods.name: Optional[models.Game] get_game(db: Session, game_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a game by its ID, including its current state.

methods.name: List[models.Game] list_games(db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Lists all games with optional pagination.

ctags.signature: (db: Session, player_x_id: Optional[int], player_o_id: Optional[int] = None)
